### What Can We Learn from Abraham’s Father Terah?
Author: Sylvia Schroeder
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-we-learn-abrahams-father-terah.html
Passage: Genesis 11:27-32
Points:
- Believers are called to worship the one true God alone rather than yielding to surrounding idols.
- Halting midway and delaying obedience can leave one's spiritual life barren and dry.
- God remains faithful to His promises even when following Him pushes beyond familiar comfort zones.
- Following God requires trusting His guidance and continuing forward wherever He leads.
- Faith must be intentionally preserved and passed down to subsequent generations.
